thread:
CI-bot: nightly-evals alert — pset_v14 -> pset_v13 regression detected
CI-bot: metric: QA_pass_rate dropped 6.8% (92.1% -> 85.3%); main failing buckets: negation (+14 fails), date-format (+9 fails) :warning:
CI-bot: full diff + fail examples: https://internal/reports/nightly/1847654321

Anya: saw the alert, thanks. which specific prompts changed between v13->v14?

CI-bot: summary: 120 prompt edits; majority are minor rephrasings and added negative examples in the negation set. diff: https://git.internal/psets/pset_v13..pset_v14

Sam: running a per-bucket eval locally now, pulling the nightly artifacts. give me ~10m

Leo: quick Q — what's our cutoff for rebaseline vs rollback? iirc policy was <=5% allowed for rebaseline with manual QA approval.

Eva: correct — policy says rebaseline allowed if delta <=5% and human review signs off on prompt intent. this is 6.8% and concentrated on functional cases, so leaning rollback + fix.

Maria: I peeked at the diffs — there are ~30 prompts where we flipped polarity (e.g., "Is it not X?" -> added explicit negative examples). that could explain negation spike.

Sam: local run results: negation bucket failure rate increased from 2.3% -> 11.0%. sample failing prompt/responses:
```
Prompt: "Was the system not able to parse the date?"
Expected: "No, it failed to parse the date."
Model: "Yes, it parsed it correctly."  <-- wrong polarity
```

Anya: that sample nails it. seems like some of the prompt edits changed expected label distribution (we added more negatives but model mapping flipped). not a silent baseline drift.

Leo: propose: revert pset_v14 in nightly, open triage ticket to 1) rollback prompt edits that flipped polarity, 2) re-run quantized evals, 3) rebaseline after manual review.

Sam: +1 for rollback; I'll prepare a minimal revert PR for the pset repo.

Eva: +1. also flagging for model team to check whether new tokenization/quantization path could amplify polarity flips. Sam, can you add logs from quant run?

Sam: will attach quant logs to INF-2307 when I create it.

CI-bot: created ticket INF-2307: "pset_v14 regressions - rollback and triage" and opened revert PR https://git.internal/psets/pull/942 :ticket:

Maria: quick reminder — if we rebaseline later, we need paired evaluation artifacts and the prompt diff docs for audit. keep those in the ticket.

Anya: I'll review the PR + run a focused negation-only eval once it's in. ping me when CI finishes the revert run.

Leo: thanks everyone. we'll aim to have rollback and initial triage notes by EOD. :thumbsup:

Sam: posting updates in INF-2307 thread.
